newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close strong on EU tender.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close strong on EU tender.

text.p: An EU export tender award at the top end of expectations helped LIFFE wheat futures pull up in late trading and re-test the day's highs, brokers said.
But there had been steady buying interest to underpin the market all day. "A lot of shippers now feel that the downside is minimal," one trader said.
This sentiment had outweighed the effects of sterling's strength, which at one point had brought prices down, he said.
Active May last traded up 0.35 stg at 96.45 stg per tonne on volume of 164 lots. May wheat's high of the day was 96.50 stg.
Barley prices eased on the day, with active March last traded 0.25 stg lower at 92.25 stg on volume of 49 lots of a total 89 lots of barley.
